barra.estado.guardando.ayuda: It saves itself a moment after each change.
barra.estado.errores.ayuda: Fix the fields marked in red and it will save itself.
barra.estado.incluido.ayuda: Built-in themes can't be changed. Use “Save as…” to get your own copy.
barra.estado.sin_guardar.ayuda: This is a built-in theme: your changes are only kept with “Save as…”.
barra.tema.ayuda: Theme you're editing. Change it to open another one.
barra.borrar.ayuda: Move this theme to Luzeira's trash (it can be recovered).
barra.simulado.ayuda: The preview is an approximation drawn by the browser; in the app, Luzeira draws it exactly as it shows on the display.
barra.pastilla.ayuda: Click to choose the display in “Settings”.
barra.restaurar.ayuda: Go back to how the theme was when you opened it (Ctrl+Z undoes it)
barra.guardar_como.incluido: Built-in themes don't change: save your own copy in “My themes”
barra.guardar_como.ayuda: Save a copy with another name in “My themes”
barra.guardar.todo: Everything is saved (it saves itself when something changes).
barra.aplicar.ayuda: Show this theme on the USB display now and keep it there
barra.ajustes.ayuda: Brightness, flip, choose display, start with Windows and import themes
